You'll work directly under a Senior Performance Marketing Manager who will coach and develop you across pricing strategy, promotional mechanics, and statistically rigorous experimentation — with a clear path toward a Performance Marketing Manager role.




This is not a passive support role. You'll be in the work every day — running tests, pulling analysis, building frameworks, and contributing meaningfully to offer performance across a portfolio of DTC brands. You won't specialize into one narrow lane. You'll develop across pricing, consumer psychology, funnel design, and experimentation all at once.




If you're looking for a role where performance is the culture and not just a department, this is it.

description:
About the job

About us




Glitch is an AI-native ads platform based in Dublin, Ireland. The platform runs Google Ads Search across a growing book of client accounts, with a specialist ad operations team working alongside it. The book keeps growing, so we are adding an Ad Operations Specialist to build and optimise accounts to a consistent standard.




The role

This is a full time contract role. You will own the day-to-day build and optimisation work on live Google Ads Search accounts. Our service is Search only, brand and non-brand prospecting, so you can go deep on one discipline instead of spreading thin across channels. The platform creates the campaign builds and a house optimisation playbook defines the process, so your job is to execute it precisely and improve accounts on the numbers. You report to the Head of Ad Operations & Optimisation.




What you will do

Review the platform's campaign creation. Review the campaign builds the Glitch platform creates: ad groups, phrase and exact keywords, negatives, and responsive search ads. Run the launch QA checklist in Google Ads Editor and fix anything that needs it before it goes live.




Optimise live accounts for conversions. Work live accounts towards target CPA and CPL following the house optimisation playbook: search terms audits, negative keyword work, budget and bid changes. Every decision is conversion-first, not vanity-metric-first.




Log platform bugs clearly. When you spot a bug or an anomaly in the Glitch platform, log it with clear reproduction notes so the product team can find and fix it fast.




Recommend strategy improvements with evidence. Read the account data and flag what should change. Bring the recommendation and the evidence behind it, not a hunch.




Write client-facing performance summaries. Produce performance summaries and reports as needed, written clearly enough for a non-technical business owner to understand what happened and what comes next.




What we need
2+ years hands-on Google Ads Search experience managing live budgets, not just observing accounts
Proficiency in Google Ads Editor for building and bulk-editing campaigns
Conversion tracking literacy: conversion actions, and the basics of tCPA and tROAS bidding
Process discipline: you follow the launch QA checklist exactly and you document your work
English fluency, written and spoken




Nice to have
Multi-account or client-service background, for example experience at an agency managing several accounts at once
Google Ads certification is a plus




Location and hours

The role is fully remote working US hours. 




Compensation

$1500 to $2000 per month depending on experience




Hiring process
Application review
A short, practical Google Ads task
Interview with the Head of Ad Operations
2nd interview with senior management
Offer




How to apply

Send your resume along with a cover letter outlining why you think you would be a great fit for the role.

This role supports go-to-market strategies, manages regional asset creation and adaptation, oversees




campaign content and creative alignment, and drives organic social media strategy. The position serves as a




critical liaison between regional and global marketing teams, agencies, and internal stakeholders, ensuring




operational efficiency, brand consistency, and timely execution of all marketing initiatives.




Essential Duties & Key Responsibilities




Drive Go-To-Market Strategies




* Work in collaboration (provide brief/insights) with Regional and global Marketing Team




regarding 18-month Mexico Marketing plan.




* Provide operational support for all Mexico Brand marketing initiatives (including PR, Events and




Sports Marketing)




* Collaborate with Mexico channel marketing to develop calendar to optimally “flight” retail




marketing activities across the calendar year, through both UA retail channels and 3rd party




channels online and offline.




* Lead Seeding Process for LATAM supporting our Go To Market strategies, aligning with the




different marketing cross-functional areas and consolidating their needs.




* Establish Mexico cross-functional alignment through weekly meetings and other touchpoints




with the team.







Regional Assets Adaptations and Creations:




* Oversee marketing asset development, localization, and distribution for LATAM markets,




ensuring consistency and efficiency.




* Manage timelines, workflows, and approvals for key campaigns, product launches, and seasonal




initiatives.




* Optimize processes for asset sharing and collaboration across regional teams, external partners,




and agencies.




* Maintain and improve the LATAM marketing hub (SharePoint and OneDrive) for easy access to




brand materials, guidelines, and execution files.




* Responsible for the translation process of copy deck, assents videos and any marketing support




element.




* Collaborate as project manager for all LATAM Campaign Creation projects.







Content Management




* Lead the creative review process, ensuring that all visuals, copy, and campaign materials align




with Under Armour’s brand standards and resonate with LATAM audiences.




* Support the development of regionally relevant content for LATAM’s key markets, adapting




global assets when needed.




* Manage the briefing process, ensuring marketing and creative teams receive clear, structured




direction.










LATAM Social Media handles:




* Lead organic social media strategy and content creation, ensuring its alignment to regional




marketing objectives and brand strategy.




* Provide strategic direction and feedback to social media agencies, while empowering them to




handle day-to-day execution, content planning, and coordination with markets.




* Ensure that content strategy, engagement tactics, and campaign integrations are in place, while




reviewing key deliverables to maintain brand consistency.




* Guide performance improvements and optimizing workflows










Qualifications




Education & Experience

 Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field.

 5–7 years of experience in marketing operations, brand management, or integrated marketing roles, ideally within a regional (LATAM) or global organization.

 Experience working with cross-functional and cross-cultural teams, preferably within the consumer goods, apparel, or sports industry.

Proven ability to manage complex marketing calendars, campaigns, and content across multiple

markets.

Technical & Functional Skills Solid understanding of go-to-market processes, including seeding, retail channel activation, and campaign execution.

 Strong project management skills: able to manage multiple timelines, priorities, and stakeholders.

Proficiency with digital tools and platforms such as SharePoint, OneDrive, project management

 systems and content management tools.




Experience collaborating with creative teams and agencies, including briefing, reviewing, and approving marketing assets.

 Familiarity with organic social media strategy and best practices for engagement across platforms (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, etc.).

Bilingual or fluent in Spanish and English (Portuguese is a plus).




Soft Skills & amp; Competencies




Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in problem-solving.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

Culturally sensitive and adaptable across different LATAM markets

Team player who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced, and dynamic environment.

Strong sense of ownership and accountability for delivering high-quality execution.







Other Requirements




Behavioral Attributes of Ideal Candidate: include but are not limited to the following:




Team Player. Loves being part of a team, both leading and serving; demonstrated deep commitment to colleagues; highly effective in a matrix environment

Humble & Hungry. Confidence without arrogance; driven to continually “up their game" regardless of prior successes

Unparalleled Integrity. In good times and bad, lives the UA Way; takes ownership for mistakes; delivers tough messages directly; doesn’t “back-channel”

Action Oriented. "Can do" and "does do" attitude; authentically engaged with people and situations. Comfortable with fast-paced work environment.

Accountable. Commits to stretch goals and delivers; holds self to highest performance standards “Gets” Under Armour. Passionately embraces the challenge and effort to keep UA unique;committed to go the extra mile to build/protect the brand.




Please send your resume and salary expectations to letsrock@buentipo.com. Thank you.

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter (in English) detailing your experience with SEO, social media, and client communication.

About the job

Job Title: Salesforce Developer (Remote)
Work Mode: Fully Remote
Schedule: Flexible (up to 40 hours per week, based on project availability)




Role Overview:

We are looking for software engineers across Latin America to join a paid remote AI training program. In this role, you will review and evaluate AI-generated code, rate AI responses for accuracy and quality, and write coding challenges to help improve AI model performance. This is a flexible, remote opportunity well-suited for software engineers seeking project-based, asynchronous work. No prior AI experience required.




Key Responsibilities

Review and evaluate code written by AI models for accuracy, efficiency, and best practices
Rate AI responses across key dimensions including correctness, instruction-following, and quality
Write original computer science questions and coding challenges to test AI capabilities
Identify bugs, errors, and inconsistencies in AI-generated code using structured guidelines
Provide clear, constructive, and structured written feedback to improve AI responses
Follow project guidelines, quality standards, and confidentiality requirements




Qualifications

Software engineering experience — junior, mid-level, or senior welcome
Proficiency in one or more of the following: Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, C++, Swift, or Rust
Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills
Background in full stack, backend, frontend, mobile, or any engineering discipline

Candidates must be legally authorised to work in one of the following locations:
Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Belize, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Dominica, Ecuador, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Mexico, Nicaragua, Panama, Paraguay, Peru, Puerto Rico, Trinidad and Tobago, Uruguay, Venezuela

Work Arrangement

Fully remote and asynchronous
Flexible workload depending on project availability
Free access to leading AI tools worth $200+/month included




Equal Opportunity Statement Selection decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and project requirements. We are committed to inclusive and fair engagement practices and consider all qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics.

title: Product Manager
description:
About the job

Sobre MAD Tech

En MAD Tech desarrollamos soluciones SaaS impulsadas por inteligencia artificial para medir, analizar y optimizar medios tradicionales, digitales y OOH.

Operamos en México, Colombia y España, desarrollando productos que ayudan a marcas, agencias y medios a tomar mejores decisiones a partir de datos.

Estamos creciendo rápidamente y buscamos una persona que quiera construir productos desde etapas tempranas y participar directamente en su evolución.




Sobre el puesto

Buscamos un Product Manager con muchas ganas de aprender, ejecutar y crecer profesionalmente.

Trabajarás muy cerca de los founders, el CTO, el equipo comercial y UX/UI para ayudar a organizar el roadmap de nuestros productos, convertir necesidades de clientes en funcionalidades y asegurar que cada desarrollo genere valor para el negocio.

No buscamos a alguien que llegue con todas las respuestas. Buscamos una persona curiosa, analítica y con iniciativa, capaz de entender problemas, hacer buenas preguntas y coordinar equipos para llevar las ideas a producción.




¿Qué harás?

● Ser el owner del roadmap, identificando las prioridades y actualizando siempre el estado de los productos y peticiones.

● Levantar requerimientos con clientes, equipo comercial, sabiendo analizar solicitudes asegurando que el producto cumpla con las necesidades del cliente.

● Traducir necesidades de negocio en historias de usuario y especificaciones funcionales.

● Priorizar tareas junto con el CTO y los founders con base en valor para el cliente, impacto comercial, esfuerzo técnico, margen y repetibilidad.

● Coordinar el desarrollo de nuevas funcionalidades con UX/UI e Ingeniería.

● Participar en pruebas de producto y validación de nuevas funcionalidades.

● Dar seguimiento al avance de desarrollos y comunicar prioridades.

● Analizar feedback de clientes para identificar oportunidades de mejora.

● Colaborar en la definición de nuevas funcionalidades, MVPs y mejoras continuas.

● Ayudar a documentar procesos, funcionalidades y decisiones de producto.




¿Qué buscamos?

● Entre 2 y 4 años de experiencia en Product Management, Product Owner, Business Analyst o roles similares.

● Experiencia trabajando con equipos de desarrollo de software.

● Interés por productos SaaS, tecnología, datos o inteligencia artificial.

● Capacidad para organizar información y priorizar múltiples iniciativas.

● Buenas habilidades de comunicación.

● Pensamiento analítico y orientación a resolver problemas.

● Facilidad para trabajar con equipos multidisciplinarios.

● Inglés intermedio o avanzado.




Será un plus si tienes experiencia en:

● Productos B2B.

● Analytics o Business Intelligence.

● AI, Martech, Adtech o Media.

● Herramientas como Jira, Notion, Figma o similares.




El perfil ideal

Nos interesa una persona con iniciativa, organizada y con ganas de crecer dentro del área de producto.

Valoramos más la capacidad para aprender rápido, entender las necesidades del cliente y coordinar equipos que una larga trayectoria liderando organizaciones.

Si disfrutas resolver problemas, convertir ideas en productos y trabajar muy cerca del negocio y la tecnología, este reto puede ser para ti.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

● Participar en la construcción de productos de inteligencia artificial con impacto internacional.

● Aprender directamente de founders y líderes de tecnología.

● Mucha autonomía y espacio para proponer ideas.

● Exposición a proyectos para México, Colombia y España.

● Crecimiento profesional dentro del área de Producto.

● Modalidad híbrida.




Ubicación

● Ciudad de México.

● Modalidad híbrida.

● Tiempo completo.

description:
About the job

DATOS GENERALES DEL PUESTO










Propósito:




Entender científicamente por qué el público forma las percepciones que tiene sobre los clientes, y diseñar experimentos que validen si las estrategias de cambio de percepción están funcionando antes de escalarlas. 










Reporta a:




Administrador General

Director General







Dirige a:




equipo de insight

$74,250.00 mensuales (bruto).










Prestaciones:




De Ley.










Relaciones internas:




gerente de proyectos

coordinador de comunicación

departamento de datos







Relaciones externas:




nulas







REQUISITOS DEL PUESTO










Escolaridad:




Licenciatura en Economía, con maestría o especialización en Economía Conductual, Behavioral Economics o Psicología Económica.










Experiencia:




3-5 años en: proyectos reales de comunicación, marketing, política pública o investigación de mercado.










Habilidades / Conocimientos:




Conocimiento sólido y aplicado de sesgos cognitivos y teoría de cambio de actitudes (Kahneman, Thaler, Cialdini).

Diseño de experimentos y A/B testing: definir hipótesis, grupos de control, métricas y análisis de resultados.

Manejo de herramientas estadísticas para analizar experimentos: R o Python con librerías estadísticas (scipy, statsmodels).

Experiencia práctica con modelos de análisis de sentimiento y clasificación de texto, idealmente en español.

Capacidad de trabajar en equipo multidisciplinario y traducir conceptos académicos en recomendaciones prácticas que el equipo de Estrategia pueda ejecutar sin un doctorado en economía.







CARACTERÍSTICAS DESEABLES










Experiencia:




En contextos político-electorales, comunicación de gobierno o análisis de opinión pública.
















RESPONSABILIDADES










Análisis conductual:




Identificar y documentar los sesgos cognitivos, heurísticas y mecanismos psicológicos que explican por qué el público percibe a un cliente de cierta forma (sesgo de confirmación, efecto halo, anclaje, aversión a la pérdida, entre otros)

Trabajar junto con el equipo de insights para construir una explicación integral de la percepción de cada cliente.

Traducir ese análisis en recomendaciones concretas para el equipo de Estrategia: qué tipo de mensajes, narrativas o intervenciones tienen mayor probabilidad de mover la percepción dado el perfil conductual del público objetivo.







Diseño experimental y validación:




Diseñar experimentos y pruebas controladas (A/B testing de mensajes, narrativas o contenido) para medir qué estrategias de cambio de percepción funcionan mejor antes de lanzarlas a escala.

Definir métricas de éxito conductual para cada proyecto.

Analizar los resultados de los experimentos junto con el Data Scientist Sr. para extraer conclusiones accionables.

Anticipar efectos secundarios no deseados de una estrategia antes de lanzarla .







Contribución estratégica:




Participar activamente en el diseño de la estrategia de cada cliente aportando el marco conductual: qué intervenciones son más efectivas para cambiar una creencia ya instalada en el público

Documentar aprendizajes de cada proyecto para construir un acervo de conocimiento interno sobre qué funciona en el contexto político y cultural específico del país.

description:
About the job

Orchid a global strategic design collective born in 2008, focused on product marketing, now grown into a vibrant team of creative minds around the world, with main hubs in NYC, Singapore and Dubai. Our multicultural team speaks 17 languages and represents 18 nationalities, blending perspectives to create visual stories and digital experiences that truly resonate.




As innovation accelerates, great products can transform lives, if people know how to use them. Orchid crafts strategic, product-driven narratives that bridge this gap, turning complexity into compelling stories that drive adoption and make technology accessible. Adaptability flows through our work as we collaborate across continents. Here, your ideas can travel globally, supported by passionate professionals who value fresh thinking and creative solutions.




In Orchid, transparency guides our relationships, ensuring your contributions are recognized and your voice is heard. In our tight-knit, collaborative crew, you'll find room to grow as you help brands tell their stories in ways that are both beautiful and strategic. Your unique perspective isn't just welcomed—it's essential to our success.




Who: 

As Orchid grows its portfolio, there is a need for supporting our clients better. We’re looking for Motion Designer/s on a contract to join our NALA team from anywhere in the region. The Motion Designers work at the heart of the agency, focused on creating high-quality motion graphics and 3D animations that support product marketing initiatives. Working closely with product marketing, creative, and growth teams, the Motion Designer will translate complex product features into clear, engaging visual narratives for videos, product launches, tutorials, and digital campaigns. Day-to-day responsibilities include developing concepts, storyboards, and style frames; designing and animating 2D and 3D assets; collaborating on video production pipelines; and ensuring brand consistency across motion deliverables. The Motion Designer can be based anywhere in NALA, such as Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Peru etc. 

What You'll Do

Interpret creative briefs and translate them into compelling visual concepts.
Understand client brands, marketing objectives, positioning and target audiences before beginning production.
Collaborate with project leads to estimate effort, timelines and production schedules.
Develop moodboards, visual directions, storyboards and keyframes for internal reviews.
Produce high-quality 2D and 3D motion graphics, animations and visual assets using industry-standard tools.
Collaborate with designers, copywriters and creative leads to deliver cohesive visual storytelling.
Select and integrate appropriate animation styles, typography, colours, imagery, video and audio.
Iterate designs based on feedback while maintaining creative quality and consistency.
Keep project stakeholders updated on production progress and proactively flag risks or blockers.
Organise and maintain production files, ensuring all working and final assets are properly named and stored.
Create visual assets for Orchid's case studies and portfolio documentation.
Participate actively in creative discussions, team reviews and internal knowledge sharing.
Stay informed on emerging trends, tools and techniques in motion design, 3D and AI-assisted creative workflows.

What We're Looking For

3–6+ years of experience in motion graphics or animation
Strong portfolio demonstrating both 2D and 3D motion design.
Excellent understanding of animation principles, timing, pacing and visual storytelling.
Strong eye for typography, composition, colour and layout.
Ability to translate abstract ideas into engaging visual narratives.
Comfortable working across multiple projects with competing priorities.
Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Self-motivated and comfortable working remotely.

Tools & Software

Experience with most of the following:

Adobe After Effects
Cinema 4D or Blender
Adobe Illustrator
Adobe Photoshop
Adobe Premiere Pro
Redshift, Octane or Arnold (preferred)
Figma
Familiarity with AI creative tools is a plus

Freedom: We value your freedom and let you bring it to work
Autonomy & Ownership: Take charge of projects and make a real impact
Global Collaboration: Work with a diverse, international team and top-tier brands. Young, multicultural and friendly work culture
Flexible Work Culture: Remote-friendly with a results-driven mindset

Competitive Compensation and fair pay across countries

Construir y mantener los pipelines de extracción, limpieza y transformación de datos de redes sociales (X, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, entre otros).

Modelos y análisis:

Supervisar y guiar al equipo de Datos Junior en tareas de extracción, limpieza y análisis.

Documentar la arquitectura y los modelos para que el conocimiento no quede solo en su cabeza.

description:
About the job

Job Title: Digital Marketer (E-commerce)

Job Type: Full-time, Remote

Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 10AM - 6PM U.S. Eastern Time

Salary: USD $2,000 - $2,800 per month (depending on experience)

Location: Latin America (LATAM)

About The Company

Our client is a rapidly growing U.S.-based e-commerce eyewear company specializing in designer frames, prescription lenses, and premium optical products. Combining a strong customer-first approach with streamlined online operations, the company delivers high-quality eyewear solutions to customers across the United States and internationally. As the business continues to scale, they are expanding their operations team to support increasing order volumes and enhance the customer experience.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated Digital Marketer with strong e-commerce experience to lead customer retention and growth initiatives across multiple digital channels.

This role will have a heavy emphasis on email marketing strategy and execution, particularly within Klaviyo, while also supporting broader e-commerce growth efforts including paid social campaigns, TikTok Shop initiatives, influencer partnerships, and conversion optimization.

The ideal candidate combines creativity with analytical thinking, understands the customer lifecycle, and is excited to experiment with new channels that generate measurable business results.

Key Responsibilities


Own and execute the company's email marketing strategy using Klaviyo, including campaigns, automations, and customer lifecycle flows.
Build and optimize email sequences such as welcome flows, abandoned cart recovery, post-purchase journeys, win-back campaigns, and promotional campaigns.
Monitor email marketing performance and continuously improve KPIs such as revenue per recipient, conversion rates, click-through rates, and customer retention.
Support customer acquisition initiatives across paid e-commerce channels.
Assist with TikTok Shop strategy, product launches, and marketplace growth opportunities.
Coordinate influencer outreach and partnership campaigns.
Manage and optimize social media marketing initiatives across platforms including Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.
Collaborate on website improvements, merchandising strategy, and conversion rate optimization efforts.
Analyze campaign performance and provide recommendations based on data and customer insights.
Research and test emerging growth channels and digital marketing opportunities.


Requirements


Minimum of 3 years of experience in digital marketing, preferably within e-commerce or direct-to-consumer brands.
Strong hands-on experience with Klaviyo or similar email marketing platforms.
Proven success managing email campaigns and automated customer lifecycle flows that drive measurable revenue.
Experience working with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms.
Understanding of customer acquisition, retention, and e-commerce marketing metrics.
Experience with paid social advertising or other paid acquisition channels.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and optimize campaign performance.
Excellent written communication skills and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.


Nice to Have


Experience with TikTok Shop or social commerce platforms.
Experience managing influencer campaigns or affiliate programs.
Knowledge of conversion rate optimization and website UX best practices.
Familiarity with Shopify themes, Liquid, or technical marketing implementations.
Experience within the fashion, eyewear, beauty, or consumer products industries.


Success in This Role


Increase revenue generated through email marketing and retention programs.
Identify and scale profitable customer acquisition channels.
Successfully launch and grow new e-commerce initiatives such as TikTok Shop.
Improve website conversion rates and customer lifetime value.
Contribute strategic ideas that support long-term brand growth and profitability.

title: Head of Marketing & Communications
skills: Serie A de $8M USD liderada por 6 Degrees Capital, con Heartcore, Shilling y Explorer — más de $13M levantados a la fecha, con Juan Romero (ex CEO de Pearson LATAM) y Vasco Pedro (fundador de Unbabel) en el consejo.

Top 3 mundial en la GSV Cup 2023 (ASU+GSV Summit), seleccionada entre más de 900 startups de 69 países.
Fundador reconocido en "Las 30 Promesas de los Negocios" de Expansión — el ranking de los emprendedores menores de 40 que están redefiniendo los negocios en México — y portada de la revista.

Eso incluye diseñar la arquitectura de mensajes de la compañía, anticipar escenarios y preparar respuestas antes de necesitarlas, gestionar issues sensibles con criterio y sangre fría, y seleccionar, dirigir y exigir resultados a agencias de PR — tú defines la estrategia; las agencias ejecutan. Buscamos a alguien que entienda la comunicación como disciplina estratégica, no como difusión de boletines.

Ser dueño(a) del ecosistema digital de Luca. Hoy la credibilidad se decide en una búsqueda: cuando un director, un maestro o un padre busca a Luca en Google o le pregunta a una IA, lo que aparece es la marca. Posicionar a Luca y a su liderazgo. Thought leadership en LinkedIn y medios educativos y de negocios, y una estrategia donde Luca publica evidencia e ideas, no solo anuncios. Nuestro estudio con el Tec de Monterrey es apenas el primer capítulo.

Elevar la marca y el diseño. Serás guardián(a) de la identidad de Luca: dirección creativa, sistema de diseño, consistencia visual y de voz en cada pieza — desde una presentación de ventas hasta un stand, un libro o la plataforma misma. Nuestra vara es el craft de las mejores marcas tech del mundo, en una industria donde casi nadie juega a ese nivel.

Usarás IA para multiplicar la capacidad del equipo: generación y adaptación de contenido, automatización de workflows, análisis de datos, personalización a escala. El estándar es hacer con un equipo pequeño lo que la competencia hace con veinte personas — ejecutar lean no por limitación, sino por diseño.

Construir un equipo tier one. Tendrás mandato completo sobre el diseño del equipo de marketing: evaluar y desarrollar el talento actual, y sobre todo atraer a los mejores — ahora, y escalando el equipo conforme el negocio lo exija. La vara es simple: cada persona del equipo debe ser alguien de quien los demás puedan aprender. Nuestra ambición requiere un equipo A, y construirlo es parte central de tu trabajo.

Construir la marca antes de que llegue la expansión. Luca crece rápido en México y nuestra ambición es internacional. En cada nueva región y cada lanzamiento, marketing tiene que llegar antes que ventas: cuando nuestro equipo comercial toque la puerta de un colegio, el director ya debe saber quiénes somos.
7+ años en marketing B2B, con al menos 3 liderando equipos o funciones completas, y experiencia sólida en comunicación estratégica o asuntos corporativos.

Experiencia en contextos donde la venta o la marca dependen de la confianza: SaaS B2B, fintech, salud, educación — o divisiones profesionales/B2B de grandes empresas de consumo, o asuntos corporativos en industrias bajo escrutinio regulatorio o mediático.

Experiencia demostrable en comunicación estratégica y manejo de issues: has diseñado narrativas corporativas, preparado escenarios de comunicación, y navegado situaciones sensibles o de alta presión donde el qué, el cuándo y el cómo decir las cosas definían el resultado.

Experiencia seleccionando y dirigiendo agencias de PR y comunicación: sabes evaluar propuestas, negociar alcances, y ser el cerebro estratégico detrás de la ejecución de la agencia — no su cliente pasivo.

Dominio integral del marketing digital: SEO y keywords, GEO (posicionamiento en respuestas de IA), contenido y blog, sitio web y CRO, email marketing, redes sociales, reviews y reputación online, paid media y analítica. No necesitas ser especialista en cada disciplina, pero sí saber dirigirlas todas, detectar cuándo algo está mal hecho, y usar el digital como herramienta de credibilidad — no solo de leads.
Músculo de comunicación y marca, no solo performance: PR, contenido, posicionamiento ejecutivo, relación con medios.
Criterio de marca y diseño: sabes dirigir equipos creativos y agencias, y distinguir una pieza que eleva la marca de una que la diluye.
Experiencia gestionando eventos B2B como canal comercial: expos, congresos y eventos propios, con visión de pipeline y no solo de presencia.
Obsesión por la conversión: sabes leer un funnel, encontrar dónde se cae, y arreglarlo con mensaje, contenido y proceso.

Usuario(a) avanzado(a) de IA en tu trabajo diario: herramientas de IA generativa para contenido, automatizaciones y agentes para eliminar trabajo repetitivo, IA para análisis. No como curiosidad — como forma de operar. Queremos ver ejemplos concretos de cómo la IA ya multiplica tu output.

Capacidad de producir: no solo estrategia — sabes bajar a brief, guion, pieza y campaña con equipo interno, freelancers y agencias. Aquí se construye con recursos de startup y velocidad de startup: si tu mejor trabajo siempre dependió de presupuestos corporativos y cinco agencias ejecutando, este rol no es para ti. Si has logrado mucho con poco, sí.
Historial reclutando y desarrollando talento top: has construido equipos de alto desempeño, sabes identificar jugadores A en entrevistas, y la gente buena quiere trabajar contigo.
Español nativo e inglés profesional. Portugués es bienvenido.
Basado/a en CDMX o con disponibilidad para estarlo.

Un rol de liderazgo con mandato real, presupuesto, y la responsabilidad de construir tu propio equipo A. Si vienes del mundo corporativo y buscas el rol donde tus decisiones se ejecutan en días y no en comités, es este.
Una empresa internacional post-Serie A con producto probado, growth sobresaliente y un mercado enorme por ganar.
Salario y beneficios competitivos, más equity.
La oportunidad de construir la marca que redefine cómo aprenden millones de niños — primero en México, después en toda América Latina y el mundo.

About the job

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will use Salesforce data and processes to manage renewals, forecast risk, and support we are recurring revenue and retention goals for North America–based customers

Your Responsibilities


You will manage a defined portfolio of accounts with a primary focus on renewing support contracts on time and in full.
You will engage customers and channel partners ahead of contract expiration to create seamless renewal outcomes. Sending notifications of renewal expiration to customers.
You will communicate contract coverage, renewal options, timelines, and the value of continued support services.
You will ensure renewals, working toward renewal rate, churn, and forecasting Indicators set by leadership.
You will use Salesforce to manage renewal opportunities, track progress, maintain accurate contract data, receive and send customer quotes, and support forecasting activities.
You will partner with Partner Success Managers to align renewal strategies with channel partners.
You will collaborate with Sales, Channel teams, Contracts, and Operations on pricing, terms, documentation, and renewal execution.
You will provide first-line support for renewal-related inquiries, including contract scope, pricing questions, and renewal logistics.
You will identify renewal risk early and escalate to ensure leadership visibility and proactive mitigation.
You will follow established Salesforce and renewal processes to ensure data quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.


The Essentials - You Will Have


Bachelor's degree.


The Preferred - You Might Also Have


Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Renewals, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Contract Management (preferred).
Experience working with CRM tools such as Salesforce for opportunity management, forecasting, and reporting.
Experience supporting North America–based customers.

Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.

Employee Assistance Program

On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!

About the job

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will use Salesforce data and processes to manage renewals, forecast risk, and support we are recurring revenue and retention goals for North America–based customers

Your Responsibilities


You will manage a defined portfolio of accounts with a primary focus on renewing support contracts on time and in full.
You will engage customers and channel partners ahead of contract expiration to create seamless renewal outcomes. Sending notifications of renewal expiration to customers.
You will communicate contract coverage, renewal options, timelines, and the value of continued support services.
You will ensure renewals, working toward renewal rate, churn, and forecasting Indicators set by leadership.
You will use Salesforce to manage renewal opportunities, track progress, maintain accurate contract data, receive and send customer quotes, and support forecasting activities.
You will partner with Partner Success Managers to align renewal strategies with channel partners.
You will collaborate with Sales, Channel teams, Contracts, and Operations on pricing, terms, documentation, and renewal execution.
You will provide first-line support for renewal-related inquiries, including contract scope, pricing questions, and renewal logistics.
You will identify renewal risk early and escalate to ensure leadership visibility and proactive mitigation.
You will follow established Salesforce and renewal processes to ensure data quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.


The Essentials - You Will Have


Bachelor's degree.


The Preferred - You Might Also Have


Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Renewals, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Contract Management (preferred).

Experience supporting North America–based customers.

About Us

We are an early-stage, fast-growing tech company helping home service businesses scale their sales and marketing using smart software, automation, and AI.

We are a small, tight-knit team. Because we are early-stage, our product is constantly evolving and there is still a lot to build. If you love the excitement of a startup and want to help shape our future, you’ll fit right in!




What You’ll Do (The Day-to-Day)

Your main mission is to spark conversations and open doors for our sales team. You will:

Make high-volume cold calls to connect with potential customers.

Pitch our value and get prospective clients excited about our software.

Qualify leads and book appointments for our senior sales team.

Stay organized by tracking your calls, emails, and follow-ups in our CRM.

Hit your targets for daily outreach and scheduled meetings.




What We’re Looking For

- We are looking for a motivated, junior-to-mid-level professional who already has some solid outbound experience but is hungry to learn, adapt, and build a long-term career with us.

- Phone Stamina: You are genuinely comfortable spending most of your day on the phone.

- Experience: Past experience in cold calling, telemarketing, or appointment setting.

- Resilience: You handle rejection professionally and view "no" as just part of the game.

- Startup Mindset: You are comfortable with change, eager to help us build processes from scratch, and adaptable.

- Great Tech Setup: A reliable high-speed internet connection and a quiet, professional workspace.




Why You’ll Love Working Here:

- Fast-Track Career Growth: We have a clear career path designed to help you grow into senior sales roles as the company scales.

- Long-Term Commitment: We aren't looking for a quick fix. We want to invest in you and build a long-term professional relationship.

- No Corporate Bureaucracy: We are a small team where your voice is heard, and your impact is felt immediately.

- Skills for Life: Learn high-income sales skills in the booming tech industry.




Our Hiring Process (We Move Fast!)

- No endless interview rounds here. We value your time. Our hiring process is incredibly simple: just one interview with our CEO, and we make a decision. We have 4 open vacancies and are ready to hire immediately!




Our Hiring Philosophy

- We don't just hire resumes; we hire attitude and drive. We are looking for resilient, dependable people who take pride in consistent daily activity. If you are coachable, proactive, and ready to grow with an early-stage startup, we will give you all the tools you need to succeed.




Your potential leader(s):

Liliana Contreras Sandoval - Talent Acquisition Specialist

Sales, Marketing, Lead qualification, Cold calling, CRM, Automation, Artificial intelligence (AI), Appointment management

Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Business, or a related field.

If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!
